entries.source: Stripped of their magic by the dark forces that once served them, they have learned to harness the hatred that burns in their minds.
entries.target: 被那些曾经侍奉他们的黑暗力量夺去魔法的他们，开始学习如何驱使他们心头燃烧的憎恨的力量。

entries.source: Age Manipulation
entries.target: 年龄操纵

entries.source:
#{bold}#Captain Gumlarat's report#{normal}#

I have found clinician Korbek's body in his study. It seems he slit his own throat. This would explain the lack of reports in the last few days.

The reason for suicide is beyond understanding. His research has been immensely successful. Our race can now return to strength! I have read through his notes and based on his findings I will increase the procedures being used to allow for even faster birth rates. The Pride leaders will be pleased.

I see his notes also suggest the mothers may be in pain. I will allow a doping infusion to be administered to alleviate this. We would not wish our women to suffer...
entries.target:
#{bold}#纲勒瑞特队长的报告#{normal}#

我在书房里发现了巫医库贝克的尸体。看来是他割开了自己的喉咙。这便解释了为何过去几天没有任何报告呈交。

他自杀的原因令人无法理解。他的研究取得了极其巨大的成功。我族如今终于能够重振雄风！我已经读完了他的笔记，并将根据他的研究成果扩大这些工序的施行规模，以实现更快的繁育速率。各个兽人部落的领袖们定会大为欣喜。

我注意到他的笔记中还提及母体可能会感到痛苦。我将批准使用麻醉药剂来缓解这一痛苦。我们可不希望自己的女性受苦……

entries.source: Dozens - hundreds maybe? - of blood-gorged worms, of varying shapes and sizes, making a writhing, ichor-soaked sea of tooth-lined maws and sickly green skin, ready to latch onto you and drink until they burst or your veins run dry.
entries.target: 几十个，也许几百个？各种形状和大小的、吸饱鲜血的蠕虫，由布满利齿的血盆大口和病态绿色皮肤组成的、翻腾的脓水海洋，随时准备缠住你并吸你的血，直到它们胀破或者你的静脉干涸。

entries.source: Whether a pit-fighter, a boxer, or just an amateur practitioner, the Brawler's skills are still handy today.
entries.target: 无论是一个职业拳手还是个业余的门外汉，格斗技能直到现在仍然十分有用。

entries.source: A timeless elf stands before you. Even though his age is impossible to determine, you feel he has seen many things.
entries.target: 一位中年精灵站在你面前，岁月不曾在其脸上留下痕迹。尽管你不知道他活了多久，但是你仍能感到他已经遍览世间万物。

entries.source: You have destroyed the sorcerers. Sadly, the portal to the Void remains open; the Creator is coming.
entries.target: 你已经消灭了那些法师。遗憾的是，通往虚空的传送门仍然敞开；造物主即将降临。

entries.source:
Lay a trap that creates a radius 5 gravitic anomaly when triggered by foes approaching within range 1.  Each turn, the anomaly deals %0.2f temporal damage (based on your Magic) to foes while pulling them towards its center (chance increases with your combat accuracy or spell power, whichever is higher).
		Each anomaly lasts %d turns (up to the amount of time since the last anomaly dissipated, based on your Trap Mastery skill).
		The trap may trigger more than once, but requires at least 2 turns to recharge between activations.
This design does not require advanced preparation to use.
entries.target:
放置一个引力陷阱。当敌人接近至 1 格内时，陷阱会触发并制造一个半径 5 格的重力异常。每回合，异常会对敌人造成 %0.2f 点时空伤害（基于你的魔力），同时将其拉向中心；拉动成功率取你的命中与法术强度中较高者，并随之提高。
		每个异常最多持续 %d 回合；实际持续时间不超过上一个异常消散至今经过的回合数，并受你的陷阱专精技能影响。
		该陷阱可触发多次，但每次触发后至少需要 2 回合重新充能。
使用这个设计无需进行高级准备。

entries.source:
Your body is more like that of an ooze, you can split into two for %d turns.
		Your original self has the original ooze aspect while your mitosis gains the acid aspect.
		If you know the Oozing Blades tree all the talents inside are exchanged for those of the Corrosive Blades tree.
		Your two selves share the same healthpool.
		While you are split both of you gain %d%% all resistances.
		Resistances will increase with Mindpower.
entries.target:
你的身体变得像软泥怪一样，你可以分裂成2个，持续 %d 回合。
		你的本体获得原始的软泥特性，而分裂体则获得酸性特性。
		如果你习得软泥之刃系技能树，则该技能树会变为腐蚀之刃技能树。
		你和分裂体共享生命。
		当你分裂时，你和分裂体增加 %d%% 所有抵抗。
		抵抗受精神强度加成。

entries.source:
Thank you, @playername@! We both survived for the wealth of the Empire. I will bring them the news and then rest.
I do not think I want to see death so closely for some time now.
Farewell.
entries.target:
谢谢你，@playername@！为了帝国的财富，我们俩都活下来了。我会把消息带给他们，然后好好休息。
我可不希望和死神再来一次亲密接触了。
再见。
